_comment: Update weekly specials. weekOf should be the Monday of the current week.

items.name: Creamy Garden Rice Soup
items.label: Soup of the Day
items.description: A comforting blend of rice, white beans, squash, carrots, celery, onions, and garlic simmered with butter and cream.

items.name: Mediterranean Farro Salad
items.label: Seasonal Salad
items.description: Pearled farro tossed with cucumber, roasted red peppers, Kalamata olives, feta crumbles, and a bright lemon vinaigrette.

items.name: Ham & Cheddar Pressed
items.label: Featured Pressed Sandwich
items.description: Smoked ham, melted sharp cheddar, Dijon mustard, and dill pickle chips on our house bread, pressed golden and crisp.
notes: Served with pickle and Featured Side

items.name: Italian Pasta Salad
items.label: Featured Side
items.description: Tri-color rotini tossed with pepperoni, mozzarella, grape tomatoes, green bell pepper, red onion, pepperoncini, Kalamata olives, Parmesan, and Italian dressing.

items.name: Chocolate Cheesecake Cookie Sandwich
items.label: Sweet Bite of the Day
items.description: Creamy chocolate cheesecake filling sandwiched between two soft oatmeal chocolate chip cookies.
